name: Little Red Book
dimensions: Height 15 cm; Length 46 cm; Depth 32.5 cm
summary:
This sculpture depicts the 'little red book' - a handbook of quotations of Chairman Mao. However, the pages are blank. The book was a symbol of aggression during the Cultural Revolution (1966-1976), and some twenty years later the artist shows it resting on a fragrant bed of open blooms.
